JAKEHOE Multi-Purpose Dissolvable Cleaning Tablets 30 Count

Product Overview

JAKEHOE Multi-Purpose Cleaning Tablets are pre-portioned solid tablets that dissolve in water for routine household cleaning. Each retail box contains 30 individually wrapped tablets.

Suggested Uses

Use the prepared solution on label-approved washable hard surfaces or kitchen utensils. For compatible washable textiles, follow the care label and rinse thoroughly after soaking.

How to Use

Dissolve a tablet in a basin of water. For hard surfaces, apply the prepared solution with a towel and rinse or wipe as appropriate. For compatible washable textiles, soak for 10 to 15 minutes and rinse with plenty of water.

Package Information

Sodium bicarbonate, citric acid, sodium lauryl sulfate, sodium dodecylbenzene sulfonate, disodium EDTA, peppermint leaf extract and lemon fruit extract.

Care Notes

Follow the product label and the surface or textile manufacturer's care guidance. Test a small inconspicuous area first. Keep out of reach of children, avoid eye contact and do not mix with other cleaning products.

Redefine Winter Comfort with 360° Warmth. Why settle for a cold commute or freezing indoor drafts? The Virelleco 31-Zone Smart Heated Hoodie combines the cozy, everyday style of your favorite pullover with revolutionary heating technology. Designed for maximum coverage and powered by our included high-capacity battery, this is your personal, wearable microclimate.

Premium Benefits & Features

  • Epic 31-Zone Heating Coverage: Experience true full-body warmth. Unlike standard heated gear, our cutting-edge design features 31 strategic carbon-fiber heating elements that wrap around your back, chest, abdomen, and even down both arms, leaving no cold spots behind.

  • 4-Button Precision Control: You are in complete control of your comfort. The advanced 4-button smart switch allows you to independently heat your core, back, or arms. Turn on exactly what you need, when you need it.
  • High-Capacity Battery Included: Ready to go right out of the box! We've included a premium, long-lasting power bank featuring dual USB outputs. It delivers hours of uninterrupted warmth and can even double as a portable charger for your smartphone.
  • 3 Smart Heat Levels: Adjust to unpredictable weather instantly with a simple press. Choose from Low (77°F / Blue Light), Medium (95°F / White Light), or High (113°F / Red Light) to find your perfect temperature.
  • Everyday Style & Comfort: Built for daily life. Crafted from premium, breathable, and skin-friendly fleece fabric, it looks and feels like a high-end designer hoodie.
  • 100% Machine Washable: Easy to care for and designed to last. Simply remove the battery pack, zip up the pocket, and toss the hoodie into your washing machine on a gentle cycle.


How to Activate Your Heat

  1. Connect: Unzip the inner pocket and plug the built-in USB cable into your included power bank.
  2. Activate: Press and hold the main power button for 3 seconds until the LED lights illuminate.
  3. Customize: Press any of the 4 independent zone buttons briefly to cycle through the 3 different temperature settings.

SAFETY REMINDER: This sewing machine is not intended for use as a toy. Please ensure that children do not operate it.

STITCHING ADJUSTMENT :If you notice loose stitching, gently tighten the upper elastic button.

DEALING WITH BROKEN THREAD: In case of a broken thread while sewing, adjust the tension by loosening the upper thread elastic button. Additionally, check for threading errors in the upper thread.
ADDRESSING KNOTS: If the bottom thread knots during sewing, verify the correct order of the upper thread threading.

THREAD ALIGNMENT CHECK: If the bottom thread is not catching on the upper thread, confirm that the sewing needle is threaded in the correct direction.

FABRIC CONSIDERATIONS: Sewing soft and stretchy fabrics, such as gauze and towels, may yield less optimal results.

POWER SUPPLY CAUTION: Choose only one power supply type; using both may result in the machine not running or sustaining damage!
